card.name: Scattered words with no shared theme
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on unrelated words such as "of" after "A total", "to" after "how", and a number or apostrophe in general web text.

modes.label: Mixed function words
modes.description: Small words like "of", "to" or "they" in the middle of ordinary prose.

card.plain: Nothing in common was found across the passages; it responds to scattered, unrelated words, so no pattern a reader could rely on emerges.
